page.title: Blade Ball Roblox Quiz: 15 Questions on Modes and Abilities
page.description_md: Can you read the ball and time your abilities? Take 15 random questions, five from each difficulty tier, drawn from a pool covering controls, modes and ability interactions.
page.seo_description: Test your Roblox Blade Ball knowledge with 15 random questions on controls, match rules and ability interactions, five from each difficulty tier.

easy.question: Which key performs Block by default on keyboard?

options.text: Q
F
Shift
R

easy.question: Which input activates your equipped Ability by default on keyboard and mouse?

F or left-click
Shift
R

L1
